_sources.wiki: OSRS Wiki Wintumber tree and Halloween scarecrow: any free non-hotspot space in the Garden or any free outdoor space of the house; the non-owner Dig-up line. Update:Halloween 2024: the scarecrow is placed just like the Wintumber tree.

looks.source: cache: hw24_poh_scarecrow_small's multiloc lists the 63 heads colour by colour, face by face, then the same 63 with crows (poh_hw24_scarecrow_active = look + 1, + 64 with crows); rev 226 recording 1686 sets hw24_scarecrow_head 50 for hw24_pumpkin_darkgreen_yay, the same order. Wiki: Change customises it like the carved pumpkin head (Colour and Carve), and crows can be invited and shooed. The Change menu's wording is not recorded: Colour and Carve are the pumpkin head's own options, the crow lines follow the Wiki's caption.
